text:
tess: quick FYI from mobile QA — at ~350px the console table overflows and the action chip sits under the title making it hard to tap. screenshot: https://img.redwood/350-overflow.png
omar: i can reproduce on a Pixel 3a. chips wrap and the row height spikes. also the right drawer overlays the last column.
li: proposal: introduce a 360px breakpoint that flips the table into dense two-line rows: title on line1, meta+actions line2. actions aligned right. keeps hit targets.
nina: +1. copy tweak: shorten "View details & actions" -> "Details" for visual label but keep aria-label="Open details and actions" for SRs.
sam: accessibility: when we flip to dense rows ensure role:list/listitem and that the overflow button has aria-expanded and controls the details region. sheet/drawer must announce "Item actions" and trap focus. close returns focus to triggering control.
tess: gesture note: row-swipe conflicts with system back on several Androids. disable row-swipe at <=420 and show explicit overflow icon instead.
omar: we should also start swipe zone 24px from edge if we must keep swipe. but disabling under 420 is safer.
li: CSS sketch: ```@media (max-width:360px){ .row{display:flex;flex-direction:column;padding:10px} .meta{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center} .overflow-icon{display:inline-flex;min-width:44px} }```
nina: visual tweak: reduce sheet shadow to rgba(0,0,0,0.10) for OLED, and ensure close icon is 44px. chevrons and overflow icons should be 48px touch targets.
sam: perf note: prefer CSS-only layout swap where possible to avoid remounting the virtualized list. lazy-mount details panel on expand.
tess: ux test: quick 3-person thumb reach tomorrow (iPhone SE, Pixel 3a, Galaxy A53) to confirm primary actions and close are reachable.
omar: i'll prototype and post a preview link. sam can run the a11y checklist in the PR.
ux-bot: preview requested: please add staging link to PR for design QA.
tess: thanks team. plan: prototype -> small QA -> a11y pass -> ship next patch. :thumbsup:
